common.structure: Single-phase simulated evaluation: one rule, two objectives. Stages: Trading Combine -> Express Funded Account (XFA) -> Live Funded Account (LFA).
common.rule_text: Do not let your account balance hit or go below the Maximum Loss Limit (MLL)
common.objective_1_text: Reach and maintain your Profit Target
common.objective_2_text: Meet the Consistency Target - your best single day should stay below 55% of your Profit Target to avoid increasing your Consistency Target
common.mll_monitoring: real-time, realized + unrealized P&L; breach liquidates immediately by market order; realized balance back above limit does not undo breach
common.mll_locks_at: starting balance (permanently) once reached by end-of-day balance
common.mll_breach_consequence: account liquidated for rest of day and ineligible for funding until Reset; subscription keeps rebilling; practice trading allowed
common.consistency_formula: Best Day Profit / Total Profit = Best Day %; new Profit Target = Best Day / 0.55 if exceeded
common.consistency_wording_conflict: Parameters page: 'below 55% of your Profit Target'; Consistency page: 'at or below 55%' computed vs Total Profit; Program Overview: 'below 55% of total profits'
common.time_limit: none (monthly subscription until pass or cancel)
common.trading_day: 17:00 CT to 15:10 CT next calendar day
common.dll_breach_effect: positions flattened, pending orders canceled, no new trades until 17:00 CT next session; funding eligibility unaffected
common.products_permitted: ES, MES*, NQ, MNQ*, RTY, M2K*, NKD, YM, MYM*, MBT*, MET*, 6A, 6B, 6C, 6E, 6J, 6S, E7, M6E*, M6A*, 6M*, 6N, M6B, CL, QM, NG, QG, MCL*, RB, HO, PL, MNG, GC, SI, HG, MGC*, SIL*, MHG, ZT, ZF, ZN, TN, ZB, UB, HE, LE, ZC, ZW, ZS, ZM, ZL (* = restricted products; SI/HG/PL currently capped at 0)
common.reset_restores: starting balance, MLL, Consistency Target, trading-day count; rebill date pushed 30 days from Reset
common.combine_purchase_limit_note: no limit on standard Combines; 'excessive purchases' is Prohibited Conduct without a number
common.after_pass: account closes, subscription auto-cancels; XFA balance starts at $0; profits do not carry over; status may take up to 30 minutes
common.automation_conditions: no support/exceptions; must originate from personal device (no VPS/VPN); HFT and SIM-exploitation prohibited; API $29/month

prohibited.item: Cross-account hedging (single user): opposite positions in same/correlated instrument across accounts, even brief/unintentional; Combine/XFA/Live; Practice excluded; Trader-level; not appealable

Hedging ladder: modal+window to un-hedge else liquidation+flag; same-day repeat liquidation; next-day 'I agree' required; later attempts immediate liquidation; excessive = Temporary Hedging Violation (rest of day); may close permanently
Coordinated trading with others (pool risk, hedge aggregate, same/opposite strategy simultaneously)
Trading on behalf of others / account sharing / shared incentives; one profile per person (Terms Sec.16)
Account stacking: repeatedly hitting MLL in one account then switching to another for high-risk attempts
Excessive purchases of Combines or Resets (no numeric threshold; may trigger Focused Trader Program)
High-frequency trading (no numeric definition; 'hundreds or thousands of trades per day, durations in seconds' cited as abusive)
Unfair technology: software, AI, ultra-high-speed systems, mass data entry giving unfair advantage
SIM exploitation: unrealistic SIM fills, queue position, no-slippage stops, gapped-market fills, tight brackets/auto-breakeven; profits may be rejected
Price exploitation (display errors, feed delays); external or slow data feed; exploiting platform bugs
Spoofing/disruptive practices; trading outside best bid/offer
Holding a position within 2% of a product's daily price-limit lock
Purposefully trading full Maximum Position Size directly into a scheduled major news event (news trading otherwise allowed)

Tier 1 news window (CPI, FOMC decision, FOMC presser, NFP, PPI): 5 min before/after no new equity-index/metal minis; micros capped 1/3/6/9/15 (25K-250K), MHG/SIL 1/2/5/7/12; pending orders do not fill; Live <$3,000 = 1 contract
VPN/VPS/proxy/TOR/location spoofing/remote access; all order flow from personal device (servers only for data/backtest/logging)
Circumventing geo/technical restrictions; 34 ineligible country entries; 25 XFA-only countries ($200,000 total payout cap, no LFA); min age 18
Trading inconsistent with real futures markets or creating financial risk for Topstep; catch-all: uncommercial, games the market, not viable, not responsible trading (sole discretion)
Terms Sec.8: substantially larger position sizes or substantially different number of positions vs one's other trades fails market-standard risk management
Bad-faith chargebacks; unprofessional behavior (falsified screenshots, promo abuse, intentionally depleting an LFA, excessive XFA use)
Overnight/swing holds: flat by 15:10 CT (or earlier product close; 15 min before holiday early close)
No explicit DCA/averaging-down/martingale ban found; nearest: 'Size up after a loss' (don't), RTP trigger losers>winners, Terms Sec.8; catch-all applies
Consequences: warning; delete trading day; Reset; permanent closure; payout delay/denial; profits removed; balances forfeited; no refund; appeal within 30 calendar days, one review, factual only
Responsible Trading Program for reckless patterns: mandatory DLL on new accounts, Consistency-only new XFAs, exit after $10,000 LFA profit
Focused Trader Program: Corrective (close all accounts, 1 active $50K account, 6 months) / Slowdown (no new Combines/Resets/B2F)
